arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/click/core.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('click.core')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from click import Context, Command
cmd=Command('probe')
ctx=Context(cmd)
m1=ctx.meta
m2=ctx.meta
print('meta_identity', m1 is m2, m1 is ctx.meta)
assert m1 is m2 and m1 is ctx.meta
m1['f2key']='f2val'
print('meta_shared_visible', ctx.meta.get('f2key'), m2.get('f2key'))
assert ctx.meta.get('f2key')=='f2val'
assert m2.get('f2key')=='f2val'
assert ctx.meta is m1
print('meta_shared_ownership', True)

PYREPLAY
